description: Create or update a contact matched by email or phone. If a contact with the given email or phone exists it will be updated; otherwise a new contact is created.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

companyName.description: Company name associated with the contact

locationId.description: Location ID the contact belongs to

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

tags.description: Array of tag strings to apply to the contact

name: crm_upsert_contact
